env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd iso
logos build .
logos run .
stdout '^iso-ok$'
cd ..

cd ws/a
logos build ./...
logos run .
stdout '^ws-ok$'
cd ../b
cp logos-strict.toml logos.toml
cd ../a
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::extension_not_enabled\] y\.⚡: extension \.⚡ is not enabled by logos\.toml strict_files'
cd ../..

cd args
logos build main.lgo x.⚡
cd ..

-- iso/go.mod --
module example.com/iso

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep v0.0.0 => ./dep

-- iso/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep/p"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(p.Msg()) }

-- iso/logos.toml --
[project]
strict_files = [".lgo"]

-- iso/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- iso/dep/logos.toml --
this is not valid toml [[[

-- iso/dep/p/x.⚡ --
package p

func Msg() string { return "iso-ok" }

-- ws/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./a
	./b
)

-- ws/a/go.mod --
module example.com/a

go 1.27

-- ws/a/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/b/p"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(p.Msg()) }

-- ws/a/logos.toml --
[project]
strict_files = [".lgo"]

-- ws/b/go.mod --
module example.com/b

go 1.27

-- ws/b/p/y.⚡ --
package p

func Msg() string { return "ws-ok" }

-- ws/b/logos-strict.toml --
[project]
strict_files = [".lgo"]

-- args/go.mod --
module example.com/args

go 1.27

-- args/logos.toml --
this is not valid toml [[[

-- args/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(Zap()) }

-- args/x.⚡ --
package main

func Zap() string { return "args-ok" }
